details:
- CVE-2026-32280: rebuild with newer golang to fix uncontrolled resource
  consumption in crypto/x509 chain building, where attacker-supplied
  intermediate certificates differing only in non-critical extensions bypass
  the dedup check and cause excessive work past the signature-check limit
  (denial of service); fix carried by golang >= 1.22.9-1.tuxcare.els9 via
  upstream Go commit 7b4ed1d7 (release-branch.go1.26), CL 758320
